# SF Memo

> Memory for AI.

SF Memo is building HBM chips for GPUs, AI Accelerators and SOCs.

Canonical website: https://sfmemo.com/
Contact: root@sfmemo.com

## Current work

- SF Memo's proprietary Verilog chip designs are being used by leading U.S. frontier AI labs to design the next generation of American AI chips.

## Objective

- A domestic path from memory architecture through advanced packaging to HBM manufacturing in California, using particle-accelerator-powered X-ray lithography, precision optics, and high-speed wafer systems to pattern advanced 300 mm wafers.

## Primary source
